summary.zh: 音频加原词，用本机 whisper.cpp 只取时间。63 秒那首 16/16，中位差 0.12 秒。把歌词当 prompt 会让重复段消失。
summary.en: Audio plus the original lyrics. Local whisper.cpp supplies timestamps only. The 63-second song matched 16/16, median error 0.12s. Feeding the lyrics as a prompt dropped the repeated section.

summary.zh: 实测过一套 6 格戒烟条漫：先核查事实，再逐格出图、后期填中文。11 次生成才留下 6 张；锚定词不能消除角色漂移。
summary.en: A real 6-panel quit-smoking strip: facts first, then serial image generation and composited Chinese. 11 generations yielded 6 usable panels. Anchor prompts reduce character drift; they do not remove it.

title.zh: 云雀智能笔：IF 设计金奖产品
title.en: Skylark Smart Pen: IF Design Gold Award Winner

summary.zh: 就是红点 2022 的 YQ·SKYLARK（一起作业）。北师大附中课堂上有点阵笔同步作答的报道；闵行智慧纸笔项目覆盖全区公办中小学。
summary.en: This is YQ·SKYLARK, Red Dot 2022. A People's Daily report shows the 17Zuoye pen in a BNU high-school class. Minhang's smart paper-pen project covered the district's public schools.

summary.zh: 用访谈把回忆收成传记，原话不改成书面语，没说过的细节不编。页面不放虚构人物的原话。
summary.en: An interview that becomes a biography without sanding off the speaker’s wording or inventing missing facts. The page does not include a fictional life story.

summary.zh: 按忌口和过敏排家常菜，采购清单要能指回每一道菜。页面上的周二菜单是虚构示例，不是某一户的真实一周。
summary.en: Plans home cooking around allergies and refusals, and every shopping line points back to a dish. The Tuesday menu is a fictional example.

summary.zh: 从一句情绪写出歌词、曲风提示词和分镜。已有「假期综合征」的完整词和 Suno 提示词；这次没有生成音频，不能当成一首已发行的歌。
summary.en: Turns one emotion into lyrics, a Suno style prompt, and a storyboard. One finished text package exists ('back-to-work blues'). That run did not generate audio.
